projects.name: zEnv
projects.description: A zero-knowledge secret manager where secrets are encrypted client-side — the server stores only ciphertext and can never decrypt anything. Built solo end-to-end in under a week, shipping as four components: a Go API, TypeScript SDK, Cobra CLI, and a TanStack Start dashboard. Features a custom Go crypto engine using Argon2id + AES-256-GCM + X25519, with a byte-identical TypeScript port via the Web Crypto API. Redis AOF-buffered audit logs are flushed to monthly-partitioned Postgres.

projects.name: Permi
projects.description: Co-founded and engineered a SaaS platform for tracking CSLB contractor licenses in the US market. Led a full frontend and backend overhaul — migrating the database schema to org-level licensing, rewriting the license service and expiration worker, rebuilding the marketing and pricing pages, and fixing a split-brain theme system. Set up billing via Polar, migrated infra from Neon to Railway Postgres, and integrated Cloudflare Email Routing with Resend.
